en.headline: Cats musical closes Hong Kong run with final shows at Xiqu Centre
en.dek: Andrew Lloyd Webber’s production ends its extended season on Sunday at the Grand Theatre in West Kowloon after performances since early August.
body: The international touring production of Cats plays its last Hong Kong performances on Sunday at the Grand Theatre of the Xiqu Centre in the West Kowloon Cultural District.
Shows are scheduled at 2.30pm and 7.30pm. The run, which opened on 6 August, was extended twice because of demand and now concludes after more than five weeks.
Tickets remain available through Cityline and other authorised platforms. The production is performed in English with Chinese surtitles and lasts about two hours and 40 minutes including an interval.

zh.headline: 音樂劇《貓》周日於戲曲中心上演最後兩場
zh.dek: 安德魯·萊特·韋伯作品於西九戲曲中心大劇院完成加場後今日結束香港站，自8月初開演以來已延長兩次。
body: 國際巡演版音樂劇《貓》周日於西九文化區戲曲中心大劇院上演香港站最後兩場，時間為下午2時30分及晚上7時30分。
製作於8月6日開演，其後因反應理想兩度加場，整個檔期超過五星期，今日正式收官。
門票仍可於Cityline等授權平台購買。演出以英語進行，附中文字幕，連中場休息全長約兩小時40分。
